definitions.explanation: A fast-moving torrent of mud, rocks, and water that rushes down a mountain stream or slope, usually set off by heavy rain. One of the main kinds of {土砂|どしゃ}{災害|さいがい} (sediment disaster) in Japan's rainy season.

examples.japanese: {土石流|どせきりゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}した→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{土石流|どせきりゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}まっている→高まる：02066_takamaru⟧。
examples.english: The heavy rain has raised the risk of debris flows.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}あい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{集落|しゅうらく}→集落：19622_shuuraku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{土石流|どせきりゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{襲|おそ}われ→襲う：01915_osou⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{押|お}し{流|なが}された→押し流す：06382_oshinagasu⟧。
examples.english: A debris flow hit a mountain village and swept away many houses.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {土石流|どせきりゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧: a debris flow occurs
- {土石流|どせきりゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{襲|おそ}われる→襲う：01915_osou⟧: to be hit by a debris flow
- {土石流|どせきりゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれる→巻き込む：05753_makikomu⟧: to be caught in a debris flow

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{土砂崩|どしゃくず}れ→土砂崩れ：09257_doshakuzure⟧: landslide — a slope collapsing in place

- ⟦{崖崩|がけくず}れ→崖崩れ：20245_gakekuzure⟧: a cliff collapsing
